purpose: Guide an evidence-led feature strategy or workshop document from customer and business imperatives to traceable experience cases and roadmap choices.

ordered_sections.title: Purpose and decisions sought
ordered_sections.purpose: Set the workshop scope and identify the choices participants must make.

ordered_sections.title: Evidence and customer or business imperatives
ordered_sections.purpose: Establish the observed needs and consequences that shape the work.

ordered_sections.title: Desired-experience principles
ordered_sections.purpose: State the principles used to evaluate cases and resolve tensions.

ordered_sections.title: Current experience and gaps
ordered_sections.purpose: Describe present behavior and the evidence-backed gaps to address.

ordered_sections.title: Roadmap and case overview
ordered_sections.purpose: Show how the cases relate to imperatives, principles, and roadmap choices.

ordered_sections.title: Feature and experience cases
ordered_sections.purpose: Develop each case from problem and evidence through outcome, mechanism, validation, and roadmap linkage.

ordered_sections.title: Convergence or end-state case
ordered_sections.purpose: Describe how separate cases converge when a shared destination is decision-relevant.

ordered_sections.title: Cross-case dependencies and validation
ordered_sections.purpose: Identify shared constraints, sequencing, validation, and interactions among cases.

ordered_sections.title: FAQ
ordered_sections.purpose: Address material stakeholder questions, unresolved issues, and ownership for resolution.

ordered_sections.title: Evidence appendices
ordered_sections.purpose: Provide detailed support while keeping decision-critical reasoning in the narrative.

narrative_rules: State the decisions sought before presenting feature detail.
Move from evidence to imperative, desired experience, case, validation, and roadmap implication.
For every case, identify a case ID, problem and evidence, importance, desired customer outcome, proposed mechanism, validation method, and roadmap linkage.
Let each case use the detail it needs; do not force all cases into mechanically identical blocks.
Activate technical constraints, data, fallback, experiment, dependency, migration, or convergence content only when relevant.
Make cross-case tensions, sequencing, and shared dependencies explicit.
Place an important FAQ answer in the narrative when the decision depends on it.
evidence_rules: Connect every imperative and case problem to traceable evidence or a visible assumption.
Distinguish observed outcomes from proposed mechanisms and future targets.
For metrics, retain definition, population, period, comparator, source, freshness, and caveat.
State the validation method and decision relevance for each case.
Do not infer roadmap priority or commitment from source formatting or comments.
terminology_rules: Use stable names for imperatives, experience principles, cases, roadmap items, and validation measures.
Give every case a unique durable identifier.
Use customer-outcome language separately from mechanism or implementation language.
Expand acronyms at first use unless an approved glossary marks them as established for the audience.
formatting_rules: Present the roadmap and case overview in a traceable compact format.
Use a consistent minimum case header while allowing conditional case content.
Number prioritized FAQ entries and identify owners and dates for unresolved answers.
Keep core evidence and causal reasoning in the narrative; use appendices for detail.
Apply the current organization template before default narrative formatting.
hard_fail_rules: Block publication when the decisions sought are missing.
Block publication when a case lacks its problem or evidence, desired outcome, proposed mechanism, validation method, or roadmap linkage.
Block publication when roadmap traceability is missing or contradicts the case narrative.
Block publication when evidence is fabricated, untraceable, mislabeled, or missing critical context.
Block publication when body text and tables conflict or a material contradiction remains unresolved.
Block publication when a date, owner, target, priority, or commitment is silently introduced.
Block publication when required overview context is absent without an approved exception.
Block publication when source-specific sample facts appear in a new artifact.
Block publication when language repair changes a decision or another protected meaning.
Block any full-language-conformance status unless the configured bundle, checks, exceptions, and human review are approved.
